name: Plan Liaoning CV-16
description: Liaoning aircraft carrier: Liaoning for short, named after the location where it was refitted. It is China's first aircraft carrier. The formal handover and commissioning on September 25, 2012 marked my country's breakthrough in achieving zero aircraft carriers. It is of great significance for improving the modernization level of the Chinese Navy's comprehensive combat forces, enhancing its defense combat capabilities, developing long-sea cooperation and responding to non-traditional security threats, effectively safeguarding national sovereignty, security and development interests, and promoting world peace and common development.
